2.text: According to another belief, spread much more widely among the Chuk-

3.text: chee, the deceased become, after death, a kind of keˊlet hostile to man, and

4.text: inclined to do harm. The keˊlet in question are of course those of the first

6.text: A corpse lying in the open will stand up and give pursuit when a lone

7.text: traveller passes by. The deceased is also inclined to come back to his own

8.text: house, and to harm the people thereof. I shall speak of this in more detail
